limits: Starts from the serialized inverse-fourth pivot candidate, including its known skin/target failures and one source-internal coarse-triangle crossing. This does not certify that initial map globally injective.
One common compact-displacement sequence maps all76 source muscles and16 diagnostic bones; no per-mesh or per-side branch. Fixed HRA is not moved or made a pointwise fixed surface of the deformation.

Twelve source bone anchors use128 deterministic area-stratified points each against one-way nearest HRA target surfaces. Patella/L1/L6 remain excluded from fitting; all bones get full bidirectional vertex evaluation.

Every muscle contributes32 area-stratified initial-surface points to a single skin constraint. Only unanimous outside classifications farther than2mm are penalized by excess distance. Inside, band and ambiguous points are not penalized at that evaluation. No anatomy boundary or clinical safe margin is inferred.
Sampled weighted bone and skin loss is checked after each trial; rejected trials are halved. Improvements of this objective do not imply full-surface/whole-body, organ, vascular or neural validity.
Each additional continuous compact step has derivative bound below1. This protects that step, not prior-map injectivity, Float32 triangle relations, global anatomy or biomechanical plausibility.

All full-vertex skin counts and all changed-versus-runtime pair relationships are independently evaluated after fitting. Broad crossings and strict witnesses are not penetration depths or clinical diagnoses.
